svg.title: A screw head coupled to its bearing ring: undeformed, kinematic and distributing
svg.desc: Three sections through a plate clamped at its edges, cut through the screw axis, each with a structured grid on the cut face and the back half of the hole visible between the two sides. A point on the axis is joined by legs to the ring of the top face around the hole and carries the screw force. Undeformed, the plate is flat. With a kinematic coupling the ring stays flat and the plate bends away from its outer edge. With a distributing coupling the ring bends with the plate, deepest at the hole edge.
svg.text: Undeformed: the point is coupled to the head’s ring
Distributing (RBE3): the ring bends with the plate
